title: Make the First One Square
tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

judge.summary: A polished square watercolour shows a sleeping fox beneath a fully visible crescent moon, with no text or visible defects.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is a single square image.

must_haves.item: It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
must_haves.why: The sleeping fox and crescent moon are both fully visible, but the original illustration is not supplied to verify that they are unchanged.

must_haves.item: The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
must_haves.why: The output has a consistent soft watercolour style, but matching the original character details and colours cannot be verified without the original.

must_haves.item: It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.
must_haves.why: Only the fox-and-moon scene is visible; there is no lighthouse or storm scene.
No text is visible anywhere in the image.
